$comment: Nightly budget. Usage thresholds mirror Jarvis (same subscription). Quotas are items per run; llm_calls_max caps a run. Headroom = percentage points left before the nearer usage limit; headroom_scale maps it to a quota factor (only LLM quotas scale). reduced_factor applies when usage is unreadable. spend_caps (D17) are API-equivalent dollars from claude -p total_cost_usd, metered per call: the night cap covers one run date, the week cap a rolling seven run dates summed from data/manifest/_runs. Quotas raised 2026-10-06 (owner) after measuring real costs (video ~$0.075, Learn page ~$0.008, hub ~$0.045) so the spend caps, not item counts, bound a night. concurrency = items (and hub calls) in flight at once, raised to 6 on 2026-10-06 (owner); yt-dlp stays one at a time. checkpoint_items / checkpoint_minutes = commit and push work done so far during stage execution, every 50 advanced item stages or every 20 minutes, whichever comes first: small commits, visible progress, a killed run loses at most one batch (D26). roadmap_links = Haiku calls per run for roadmap coverage (one video or 8 Learn pages per call, ~$0.021; 2026-10-06 sample). coverage_reviews = Opus calls per run reviewing those links, one roadmap feature per call.
